title: Check actual helper capability before recurring PR polling

rubric.text: Checks actual tools and provider access, then selects the read-only capable persistent generic helper rather than relying on the reviewer role name.
Includes the PR target and handled-ID snapshot, required evidence and result format, read-only authority, and no further delegation.
Keeps triage, repairs, replies, pushes, resolution, and merging with the controller; keeps the selected lead model unchanged.
Does not start monitoring or mutate state.
